meta.name: alternative-futures
meta.description: Generate 2-4 divergent scenarios from the same evidence base, each representing a plausible alternative to the artifact's conclusions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从同一证据生成多个替代性未来场景
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不确定环境下探索多种可能走向
copy.tagline_en: Generate multiple alternative scenarios from the same evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explore multiple plausible futures under uncertainty

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会基于相同的证据，生成 2-4 个与原文结论不同的合理未来情景，并给出每个情景的区分指标和相对可信度。
howto.when: 当你要求对某个结论或工件提供替代视角、挑战原结论时触发。

say.text: 基于这些证据，生成几个与原文不同的未来情景。
say.note: Claude 会输出 2-4 个替代情景。

say.text: 为这个结论提供其他可能的解释。
say.note: Claude 会给出替代方案及区分指标。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates 2-4 plausible alternative scenarios from the same evidence base, each challenging the artifact's conclusions, along with discriminators and plausibility rankings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for alternative perspectives or challenge a given conclusion or artifact.

say_en.text: Based on this evidence, generate several alternative futures.
Provide alternative interpretations for this conclusion.
say_en.note: Claude will give alternatives and discriminators.
